headline: Homeland Update
title: Homeland Update | Three story RV and weather | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo's Homeland got big upgrades this season. Your R V can now have three stories and a full skin replacement. Home also supports a weather system. You can apply a full blueprint plan and share blueprint codes with other players. Reach R V level twenty to claim the new Glow Scooter from the level reward. Which upgrade do you want most? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Homeland update: three-story RV, full RV skin replacement, Home weather system, blueprint plans and shareable codes, and the Glow Scooter reward at RV level 20.
